description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingSearchCommand' in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch' package. The interface extends other command-related interfaces and provides default methods for search command properties such as type prefix, resource type, selected fields, and namespaces. It is intended for use in the Eclipse Ditto project for handling search commands related to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommand
classes.description: A Java interface representing search commands in the 'thingsearch' context, providing methods to access command properties such as type prefix, resource type, selected fields, and namespaces.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldSelector for specifying which fields to include in the retrieved entity, or empty if not specified.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns an Optional set of namespace strings for the search command, or empty if not specified.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for the search command, typically used to identify command kinds.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the resource path; defaults to an empty pointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string indicating this is a 'thing-search' entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the command and returns the modified command.
